sections.title: Meeting Schedule
sections.content:
RFC 234 gives the schedule for a Network Working Group meeting in Cambridge, Massachusetts. The events include a System Programmers Workshop, a Network Information Center tutorial, three technical workshops, a plenary session, dinner, and a panel discussion.

The notice updates RFCs 204 and 222.
sections.plainLanguage: This is a timetable for a meeting, not a technical specification. It tells attendees which events were planned.

sections.title: Workshops and Tutorial
sections.content:
The System Programmers Workshop was scheduled for noon on Sunday, October 10, at Project MAC. The NIC tutorial and Protocol, TIP, and Data Management workshops were scheduled to begin at 9:00 A.M. on Tuesday, October 12.

People attending the three workshops were to meet first for a briefing, where their rooms would be announced.
sections.plainLanguage: The Sunday event was for system programmers. On Tuesday, a tutorial and three topic workshops were scheduled to begin.

sections.title: Plenary, Dinner and Panel
sections.content:
The plenary session was scheduled for 9:00 A.M. on Wednesday, October 13, in the Center for Advanced Engineering Study auditorium, Room 9-150. Cocktails were listed for 5:30 P.M., followed by dinner at 7:15 P.M.

A panel discussion was scheduled for 9:00 A.M. on Thursday, October 14, in the same auditorium.
sections.plainLanguage: The main session and the final panel were set for consecutive mornings. Cocktails and dinner followed the plenary on Wednesday.
